response.justification: The candidate is an experienced senior full-stack engineer with a strong web/backend background (TypeScript, Node.js, DLang) and solid engineering practices, but the profile is a poor match for this embedded networking security role. There is no evidence of Japanese language ability (a hard requirement stated as native-level), no LAN-switch, embedded firmware, or Linux kernel source-modification experience, and no exposure to the required security/networking stack (MACsec, 802.1X, NETCONF, SNMP, switch SDKs). C/C++ experience is limited to a short stint at National Instruments over a decade ago and is not listed among current skills. Multiple mandatory qualifications are unmet.
strengths: 13+ years of professional software development across diverse domains
Strong engineering discipline: TDD, CI/CD, testing tooling, open-source contributions
Comfortable with Linux, Docker, and low-latency systems work in DLang
concerns: No Japanese language proficiency indicated (hard requirement)
No embedded firmware, LAN-switch, or Linux kernel modification experience
C for UNIX development is dated (2014-2015) and absent from current skill set

key_factors.factor: Broad senior engineering experience and rapid learning track record
